position: Migration semantics are executable; the durable provider is still a future connection
headline: Every accepted queue event is ordered, hashed, replayable, and still unable to publish.
copy: The ledger makes concurrency, retries, audit continuity, recovery, and tamper evidence testable without claiming that browser or process memory is production storage.

postures.title: Event chain
postures.copy: Every event carries its sequence, previous hash, and canonical hash.

postures.title: Retry safety
postures.copy: Idempotency keys return the first accepted receipt.

postures.title: Recovery replay
postures.copy: A valid chain reconstructs the queue state deterministically.

postures.title: Durable provider
postures.copy: No production database or migration has run.

flow.title: Append
flow.copy: Check role, action, version, and idempotency before hashing.

flow.title: Verify
flow.copy: Detect sequence, previous-hash, content, or head tampering.

flow.title: Replay
flow.copy: Rebuild state only from a valid append-only chain.

decisions.label: Ledger
decisions.reason: Hash-chain and replay semantics are testable.

decisions.label: Concurrency
decisions.reason: Every command names the expected record version.

decisions.label: Publication
decisions.reason: Every resulting record preserves the lock.

locks.title: Deployment lock
locks.copy: No provider endpoint, domain, runtime, or credential is active.

locks.title: Identity lock
locks.copy: The claim contract does not authenticate a real reviewer.

locks.title: Storage lock
locks.copy: Ledger semantics are verified without a connected durable provider.

locks.title: Invitation lock
locks.copy: No invitation token, participant, or external session exists.

locks.title: Public launch lock
locks.copy: Implementation readiness cannot activate a public service.
